metadata.title: Pop Art Portrait with Halftone Textures

retrievalProfile.description: High-contrast pop art portraits featuring flat skin tones, massive dark hair silhouettes, and vibrant accent colors on eyes and lips.
triggerTerms: flat color portrait with halftone accents

recipe.visualDefinition: A stylized graphic portrait characterized by a large, textured black hair mass framing a flat-colored face with high-saturation makeup accents and a grainy, screen-printed texture throughout.
coreVisualRelationships: Massive dark hair silhouette vs. bright flat skin tone
Vibrant lip and eye accents vs. neutral face base
Halftone stipple patterns vs. solid color blocks
Subject's three-quarter gaze vs. top-right typographic cluster
coreInvariants: Minimalist facial features defined by color rather than shadow

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies 80% of the frame, positioned slightly left of center with hair extending to the edges.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The saturated red lips and dark eyes create a central focal point within the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes lead from the subject's gaze to the typographic element in the top right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The lavender background provides a soft contrast to the heavy black hair mass.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between hair and skin; high saturation on facial features.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses thick, jagged, stippled brush strokes
Secondary text uses clean, wide-tracked sans-serif
Angular, aggressive script for the primary wordmark
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters filled with halftone dot patterns
Jagged edges to simulate hand-painted texture
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, textured script paired with clean, geometric sans-serif for contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the jagged, hand-painted feel of the main title
Provides a clean counterpoint for secondary information

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast pop art portrait of a woman with massive black hair, flat peach skin, red lips, and pink eyeshadow against a lavender background with a grainy screen-print texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a textured, stippled script title in the top right corner, using a halftone dot fill and jagged edges.

verificationChecks: Is the hair a solid, textured black mass?
Are the lips a vibrant, saturated red?
Does the text feature a halftone dot pattern?
Is the background a flat lavender color?

mustRedesign: Do not use existing brand logos
Ensure text is original and not a copy of the source
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast separation between hair and face
Ensure halftone texture is visible in the text and shadows
Confirm the limited color palette is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Pop Art Portrait = (High-Contrast Silhouette Hair + Flat Color Skin) * Screen-Print Texture + (Saturated Makeup Accents) + (Halftone Textured Typography)
